toegepas.voor: Die deksel bly toe en die houer staan hoog
toegepas.na: Die deksel bly toe, en die houer staan hoog
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die deksel bly toe' and 'die houer staan hoog' are two full clauses joined by 'en', so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.voor: teen die vel vas en die water spoel swak
toegepas.na: teen die vel vas, en die water spoel swak
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Nat klere hou ... vas' and 'die water spoel swak' are two full clauses joined by 'en', so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: op jou eie hande en 'n grootmens moet dus help
toegepas.na: op jou eie hande, en 'n grootmens moet dus help
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die goed kom ... op jou eie hande' and ''n grootmens moet dus help' are two full clauses joined by 'en', so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: spoel dit dadelik met baie skoon water
toegepas.na: spoel die oog dadelik met baie skoon water
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dit' can refer to 'iets' (the substance) rather than the eye; naming the eye removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' can point to 'iets' (the substance) rather than the eye.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the eye removes the ambiguity without changing the instruction, which the next sentences already make about the eye.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Houses do not cook, and 'verhit' needs an object; 'huishoudings ... verwarm' is the natural usage, same word count.
toegepas.fout: Houses do not cook, and intransitive 'verhit' can read as 'overheat'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Party huishoudings kook of verwarm' is the natural usage with the same meaning and word count, and the protected 'paraffien' is untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A negative command takes 'moenie'; 'tel dit nie op nie' without a subject is not a correct imperative.
toegepas.fout: A negative command without a subject needs 'moenie'; 'tel dit nie op nie' is not a correct imperative.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'moenie dit optel nie' is the grammatical form of the same instruction, with nothing added or lost.

toegepas.voor: Moenie dit probeer blus of doodslaan nie
toegepas.na: Moenie die vuur probeer blus of doodslaan nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dit' follows 'die veld' and reads as the veld; the thing not to put out is the fire.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' follows 'die veld' and reads as the veld, which cannot be put out or beaten.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the fire fixes the pronoun without changing the instruction, and the protected 'As die veld brand' stays intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Goed in die huis wat skade doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Under a negative, 'of' makes clear that neither action is allowed; 'en' can read as 'not both together'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In Afrikaans 'ruik en proe nie' under one negation already means neither, so the swap to 'of' is a lateral move in a safety sentence.

laat_vaar.voor: begin dadelik spoel met baie skoon lopende water
laat_vaar.na: begin dadelik met baie skoon lopende water spoel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Standard Afrikaans puts the infinitive verb at the end after 'begin'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after 'spoel' is normal, natural Afrikaans, so moving the verb is a lateral change inside a safety instruction.

na_skrywer.blok: Medisyne help, maar net vir die regte mens
na_skrywer.voor: Medisyne word ook hoog en toe weggebêre
na_skrywer.na: Medisyne word ook toegemaak en hoog weggebêre
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'hoog en toe weggebêre' is awkward and 'toe' can be read as 'then'; same word count, same meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'hoog en toe weggebêre' is awkward and 'toe' can be misread as 'then'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is the storage safety instruction and the proposal rewords and reorders it, so the writer owns the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'kom uit' can read as 'come out'; 'word uitgetrek' says plainly that the clothes are taken off, without naming who does it.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Die klere kom uit' is loose and does not plainly say the clothes are taken off.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The vagueness is real, but this is a first-aid instruction (what to do, while rinsing), so the writer should choose the wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Stap nooit terug in vir iets
na_skrywer.na: Gaan nooit weer in om iets te haal
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'terug in vir iets' copies English 'go back in for something'; the Afrikaans needs 'om iets te haal'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Stap nooit terug in vir iets' copies English 'go back in for something'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The anglicism is real, but the fix rewords a fire-safety instruction (new verb, 'weer', 'om ... te haal'), so it goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'skoonmaakgoed' is a collective noun and does not take 'n'; 'skoonmaakmiddel' is the correct singular.
na_skrywer.fout: 'skoonmaakgoed' is a collective noun and sits awkwardly after ''n'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition and the fix swaps a noun rather than a plain spelling, so the writer must change it for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Medisyne help, maar net vir die regte mens
vlae.teks: Medisyne is 'n middel wat siekte of pyn behandel, of keer dat 'n mens siek word.
vlae.rede: This sentence restates the protected word-for-word definition of 'medisyne' but drops 'help om ... te' (the protection's reason stresses that medicine HELPS). Not changed, because it touches a decided shared definition; a person or the writer should decide whether the study text must match the glossary wording.

vlae.teks: Die merk of plakker op 'n houer wat sê wat binne-in is.
vlae.rede: The protected entry withdrew 'die etiket sê wat' because a refilled bottle keeps its old label, which is this lesson's main example; this definition states that the label says what is inside. Not the withdrawn words exactly, so not a safety flag, but the meaning sits close to it and may contradict the lesson's own point. Content decision, not changed.

vlae.teks: Spoel die vel en die oog altwee ten minste vyftien tot twintig minute lank.
vlae.rede: 'ten minste' with a range ('vyftien tot twintig') is logically unclear: the minimum is one number. Fixing it needs the intended duration, which is a safety fact, so it is left for the writer.
